function: Joint active beamforming at the primary transmitter and passive RIS phase-shift design maximizing the primary rate under covertness and secondary-SNR constraints (p. 1, p. 3).
system: Downlink MISO symbiotic radio: transmitter with L=4 antennas, single-antenna PRx and SRx, passive reflecting RIS with M=40 to 80 elements; band not stated (p. 2, p. 5).
method: Deep unfolding of gradient descent on the Lagrangian dual: trainable step sizes and offsets per layer (K=8), Adam on mini-batch Lagrangian loss, no labels (unsupervised) (p. 4-5).
data_channel: Simulated: distance-based path loss (beta0=-30 dB, exponents 2.2 to 4.2), Rician small-scale fading, fixed node positions, 1000 independent channel realizations; no public dataset (p. 5).
test_conditions: No separate test scenario is described: one simulated layout and fading model, 1000 channel realizations; sweeps over transmit power Ps and RIS size M (p. 5-6).
baselines: Learned: OADNN (DNN approximating the input-to-beamforming mapping). Non-learned: random RIS reflection coefficients; iterative gradient descent compared only in the complexity analysis (p. 5).
metrics: Maximum achievable rate of the primary receiver (bps/Hz) versus training epoch, transmit power Ps, and RIS size M (p. 5-6).
complexity: Order of complexity: DUAGD O(KJS(L+M^2)) versus GD O(TJS(L+M^2)); parameters 2(L+M^2+1+1) per layer; OADNN order given (p. 4-5).
openness: none; no code or data link (p. 1-6).
q1_support: p. 5: "large-scale fading is related to distance" and "the Rician factor": custom distance-based path loss with Rician fading, no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 5: "averages over 1000 independent channel" realizations of one layout; p. 6: "performance of two schemes increase as M increases" is a sweep over RIS size, with no model tested on a condition unseen in training.
q3_support: p. 5: "Optimization algorithm based on DNN (OADNN)" and "Random beamforming policy: We randomly select the reflection" coefficients; "The maximum rate of the DUAGD is higher than" both (Fig. 3).
q4_support: p. 5: "the DUAGD is O(KJS(L + M 2 ))", compared with O(TJS(L + M^2)) for iterative GD and with the OADNN; p. 4-5 also gives 2(L + M^2 + 1 + 1) parameters per layer.
q5_support: p. 5: "averages over 1000 independent channel" realizations from the authors' own simulator; no code or data link or public dataset anywhere in the six pages.
notes: Included, area 3: deep unfolding of GD on the Lagrangian dual for joint active (PTx) and passive (RIS) beamforming in an RIS-assisted covert symbiotic radio; covertness is a constraint and the learned function is beamforming. Fig. 3 plots rate versus training epoch, but the text compares the maximum rate with OADNN and random RIS (p. 5), so q3 is 1. Rician factor value is not given.
